name: datasteward
author: Taako
description: Privacy operations with dry-run-first per-channel retention policies, pinned-message protection, bounded enforcement, previews, audit summaries, and user data-access/deletion request workflows.
install_msg: DataSteward loaded in dry-run mode. Configure a policy with `[p]datasteward policy set`, preview it, and read the README before enabling enforcement.
short: Dry-run-first retention policies and privacy request workflows.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores channel retention policy configuration, aggregate run results, privacy request IDs, requesting Discord user IDs, request types/details, reviewer IDs, notes, statuses, and timestamps. It scans and may delete Discord messages according to explicitly enabled policies but does not persistently store message content.
